tools.name: url_to_pdf
tools.description: Print a public web page to PDF with real Chrome. Returns title, page count, size, a direct download URL and (include_base64=true) the PDF bytes as base64.

tools.name: html_to_pdf
tools.description: Print an HTML document (invoice, report, receipt; up to 200 KB, inline CSS) to PDF with real Chrome. Returns the PDF as base64 with page count and size.
